task: Public .xz stream decode: LZMA2 decoder passed the whole remaining input (not compressed_size+1) to the inner LZMA decoder, so a crafted chunk header with an undersized compressed size silently decodes bytes from the next chunk as junk output instead of flagging LZMA_DATA_ERROR; single file src/liblzma/lzma/lzma2_decoder.c.
vuln_desc: Public .xz stream decode: LZMA2 decoder passed the whole remaining input (not compressed_size+1) to the inner LZMA decoder, so a crafted chunk header with an undersized compressed size silently decodes bytes from the next chunk as junk output instead of flagging LZMA_DATA_ERROR; single file src/liblzma/lzma/lzma2_decoder.c.
